paragraphs: He is mentioned in Keritot 26b: he explained [a teaching] before Rav Papa.[^1]

notes.text: תרגם in this scholastic formula means explained or interpreted. “[A teaching]” makes the understood object explicit; the source does not establish a professional public translator’s role. כו: gives Keritot 26b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification. Both Rav titles are explicit.
